items.scope: StrongDM issues only.
Xerox Corporation issues only.
Ericsson issues only.
All products and services developed and/or sold by Panasonic Group companies.
AMD branded products and technologies only.
All ISC.org projects.

All products of Medtronic or a Medtronic company including supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered in Medtronic products that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and Eurotherm.
All ServiceNow products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by ServiceNow that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Zephyr project components, and vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Ribose products and services, including open source projects, supported products, and end-of-life/end-of-service products.
Third-party products he researches that are not in another CNA’s scope.
OceanBase products only, not including end-of-life components or products.
Hanwha Vision (formerly Samsung Techwin and Hanwha Techwin) products and solutions only, including end-of-life (EOL).
All HYPR products only.
All Rockwell Automation products.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.

Root Scope: Organizations that are cooperative partners of CERT@VDE.
CNA Scope: Products of CERT@VDE cooperative partners and brands listed at https://cert.vde.com/en/cna/. Also, industrial and infrastructure control systems (and its components) of European Union (EU) based vendors unless covered by the scope of another CNA. Partners and brands include but are not limited to: ADS-TEC Industrial IT, Auma, sipos, Beckhoff, Bender, Bucher Automation, CLAAS, 365FarmNet, Satinfo, Carlo Gavazzi Controls, Codesys, DURAG GROUP, Draeger, Endress+Hauser, Euchner, Festo Didactic, Festo, Frauscher, GEA, HIMA, Harman, Helmholz, Hilscher, K4 DIGITAL, KEB, Krohne, Kuka, Lenze, BHN Services, MB connect line, Miele, Murrelektronik, PHOENIX CONTACT, Etherwan Systems, Innominate, Pepperl+Fuchs, Pilz, SMA, SWARCO, Trumpf, TRUMPF Laser, TRUMPF Werkzeugmaschinen, VARTA Storage, VEGA, WAGO, M&M Software, Weidmueller, Welotec, Wiesemann & Theis, ifm.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by BLSOPS, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Foxit issues only.
Zscaler issues only.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
Check Point Security Gateways product line only, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Check Point that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Vulnerabilities for OTRS and ((OTRS)) Community Edition and modules only.
Lexmark products only.

Root Scope: European Union (EU) member states/EU authorities, EU CSIRTs network members, and cooperative partners under ENISA’s mandate as well as other CNAs who choose ENISA as their Root.

CNA Scope: Vulnerabilities in information technology (IT) products discovered by European Union (EU) Computer Security Incident Response Teams (CSIRTs) or reported to EU CSIRTs for coordinated disclosure, as long as they do not fall under a CNA with a more specific scope.
All Cato Networks products and vulnerabilities in third-party products affecting Cato products unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Software vulnerabilities related to the TianoCore Open Source.
Delta Electronics products as listed on www.deltaww.com.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Kaspersky B2C and B2B products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered in third-party software not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Vulnerabilities in Honor products and services unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Products and services provided by Open-Xchange, PowerDNS, and Dovecot.
Solidigm branded products and technologies.
SailPoint issues only.
All Cloudflare products, projects hosted at https://github.com/cloudflare/, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Cloudflare that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
Third-party products it researches.
Radiometer products only.
Eaton issues only.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
